results.reason: The cell does not use the shared driver. Its recipe names a bespoke recorder that builds a mock, launches it, and drives claude under --bare, with a precondition that the mock listens on localhost:18765. Claude Desktop has no --bare launch shape and no env path — it authenticates through its own OAuth — so the agent cannot be pointed at the mock. desktop_profile_validate_cell independently refuses env, mock and bare_mode for this profile, so the cell is refused before the driver starts. The cited note carries the commands.
results.missing_control: bare-mode CLI launch with a mock endpoint (claude --bare plus an env-injected base URL)
